about_short_description.short_description: Hollydesk is a platform that manages SME company's daily expenses and accounts payable from end to end.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A platform feature that allows employees to upload receipts, managers to approve or decline expenses, and finance teams to track and process payments and invoices in real-time.

product.name: Real-time Reporting
product.description: Automated real-time reporting that provides insights into company spending, allowing for better budget control and decision-making.

product.name: Supplier Management
product.description: A system to register suppliers, upload their documents, approve and pay their invoices digitally, and track and export all related data.

product.name: Business Credit
product.description: A service that provides immediate funding for cash flow, with an expandable credit limit based on spending, and real-time tracking of all payments.

product.name: Expense Reimbursements
product.description: A feature that allows employees to get reimbursed for out-of-pocket expenses quickly by uploading receipts and getting instant approval and payment.

product.name: In Advance Payment
product.description: A service where employees can request funds in advance for work-related expenses, with instant transfer upon approval and easy reconciliation.
